notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT decode: the five update kinds, the movement block (LIVING pose + 6 speeds, rider TransportPose, create-time in-progress CreateSpline with the phantom-endpoint trim, transport GO path progress) and the sparse ObjectFields descriptor accessors. MSUI's UpdateObjectParser + ObjectFields port the framing and field decode faithfully (incl. compressed form and created-mask absent=0 semantics), but the movement block only surfaces position/orientation/speeds - the three richer payloads are parsed for alignment and thrown away.
